text: Binary per-row measure from the OP's title and argument (current text, including marked edits), in the OP's own voice: 1 if the OP explicitly expresses fear or worry of social rejection or isolation (being rejected, ostracized, shunned, excluded, judged out, or left alone by others) connected to their view or its expression; 0 if no such explicit fear is present. Quoted or reported statements by other people are excluded unless the OP adopts them as their own fear. Ignore view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates and text reporting whether the outcome occurred (generic discussion of delta/platform rules is not an outcome announcement and may count if relevant); do not reconstruct an original version by removing edits. Returns null if title and argument are both missing, empty or malformed.
